name: Alaska

agency.name: Alaska Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC)
agency.division: Division of Air Quality, Air Permit Program

localAgencies.name: Municipality of Anchorage
localAgencies.notes: Handles burn permits inside Anchorage; stationary source air permits are issued by DEC.

overview: Alaska DEC's Air Permit Program issues construction permits (major sources), minor source specific permits, general permits for common source types, Owner Requested Limits (ORL), Pre-Approved Emission Limits (PAEL), and Title V operating permits under 18 AAC 50 and AS 46.14.

permitTypes.name: Construction Permits
permitTypes.description: Required for new major sources and major modifications.

permitTypes.name: Minor Source Specific (MSS) Permits
permitTypes.description: Minor permits for sources that do not need a construction permit, including drilling rigs.

permitTypes.name: General Permits
permitTypes.description: GPA (fuel-limited diesel electric plants, renewals only), MG1 (oil and gas drill rigs), MG3 (smaller asphalt plants), MG9 (smaller rock crushers), GP3 (larger asphalt plants).
permitTypes.thresholds: MG3 and MG9 are listed as General Minor Permits (under 100 TPY); GP3 as a General Operation Permit (100 TPY to under 250 TPY) (restated from ADEC's General Permits page).

permitTypes.name: Owner Requested Limit (ORL)
permitTypes.description: An enforceable limit on potential to emit to avoid permitting obligations.

permitTypes.name: Pre-Approved Emission Limits (PAEL)
permitTypes.description: PAEL1 for gasoline distribution bulk storage and PAEL2 for diesel generator facilities.

permitTypes.name: Operating Permits (Title V)
permitTypes.description: Federal operating permit program run by DEC.

permitTypes.name: Open Burn Approval
permitTypes.description: Required for certain open burning not covered by exemptions.

oilAndGas.summary: Oil and gas drill rigs can use the MG1 general permit or a Minor Source Specific permit. DEC defines Portable Oil and Gas Operations as operations that move between sites to drill or test wells.

programs.name: MG1: Oil and Gas Drill Rigs General Permit
programs.description: General permit for portable oil and gas drill rigs.

programs.name: Minor Source Specific permit (drilling rigs)
programs.description: Alternative to MG1 for drilling operations.

guidance.name: Permit Application Guidance: Where to Start

notes: Outer Continental Shelf sources off Alaska are permitted by EPA Region 10 (not verified on DEC pages). Construction and Title V tons-per-year thresholds are not restated because the DEC pages reviewed on 2026-10-30 do not state them; see 18 AAC 50.
